questions.question: After a push, how are the external URLs a repo owner registered notified, and how can the receiver tell the request is genuine?
questions.answerNote: webhookNotifier.PushCommits builds a PushPayload -> PrepareWebhooks/PrepareWebhook applies branch filter, creates a HookTask and enqueues it; Deliver sends the HTTP request with X-Gitea-Signature / X-Hub-Signature-256 (HMAC-SHA256 of the payload with the webhook secret).

questions.question: What stops someone from force-pushing to a branch the team has locked down?
questions.answerNote: git pre-receive hook calls the internal HookPreReceive endpoint; preReceiveBranch loads the protected-branch rule and rejects deletion, force pushes (unless allowlisted), unsigned commits when required, protected-file changes, and users not allowed to push.

questions.question: Where are the browser page URLs connected to the code that handles them?
questions.answerNote: routers/web/web.go Routes()/registerWebRoutes registers every web path with m.Group/m.Get/m.Post against handlers in routers/web/*; the REST API equivalent is routers/api/v1/api.go.

questions.question: How does a script calling the REST API prove who it is with a personal token?
questions.answerNote: OAuth2 auth method parseToken reads token/access_token query params (unless DISABLE_QUERY_AUTH_TOKEN) or an Authorization Bearer header; userFromToken tries OAuth JWT first, then looks up a personal access token by hash (GetAccessTokenBySHA) and sets its scope. Selection starts from an unrelated tools/ component.

questions.question: How do I change which port the web server listens on?
questions.answerNote: Set HTTP_PORT in the [server] section of app.ini (documented in custom/conf/app.example.ini); modules/setting/server.go reads it with default 3000.

questions.question: When upgrading to a newer release, where are the database schema changes applied?
questions.answerNote: modelmigration/migrations.go prepareMigrationTasks lists numbered newMigration(...) steps grouped by release (v1_6, v1_7 ... subpackages); the DB version table records the last applied id. Note: lives in top-level modelmigration/, not models/migrations.

questions.question: How do I run just one backend test locally?
questions.answerNote: docs/testing.md: go test -run '^TestName$' ./modulepath/ or make test-backend#TestName; frontend via pnpm exec vitest <filter>; integration via make test-integration#TestName.

questions.question: How is the contribution calendar on a user's profile page drawn?
questions.answerNote: TS: initHeatmap finds #user-heatmap, GETs data-heatmap-url, buckets [timestamp,count] by local date, then mounts the ActivityHeatmap Vue component (own SVG grid + tippy tooltips). Partial scanner coverage: heatmap.ts visible, .vue not.

questions.question: How does the unread-notifications badge in the header update without reloading the page?
questions.answerNote: TS: initNotificationCount subscribes to notification-count user events delivered through a SharedWorker that holds one WebSocket per URL; on worker-unavailable it falls back to periodic polling of the count. Selection starts from an unrelated web_src component.

c4Note.note: Gitea is a Go monolith (cmd/ entry, routers/ HTTP layer, services/ business logic, models/ persistence, modules/ shared libraries) with a TS/Vue frontend bundle in web_src/. The scan sees only TypeScript: one container keyed on package.json with 182 per-file components, almost all web_src/js (features 88, modules 32, utils 11) plus build/lint config files (eslint/vite/tailwind/playwright configs, tools/*.ts) promoted to peer components. No Go, no .vue files (0 entities), so the server - which is the product - is absent.
expectedContainers: gitea server (Go: cmd/, routers/, services/, models/, modules/)
web frontend bundle (web_src/js + web_src/css, built by vite.config.ts)
git repositories on disk + SSH/HTTP git transport (modules/git, routers/private hooks)
optional: act runner / Actions (services/actions) as separate system
problems: Whole Go backend (routers/, services/, models/, modules/) invisible - the Ask/atlas would describe gitea as a frontend-only project
Single container named after package.json; frontend vs tooling vs e2e tests not separated
182 components at one level, one per .ts file; web_src/js/features/* should be grouped (e.g. by feature area), not flattened
Build/lint config files (eslint.config.ts, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.ts, tools/*.ts) are components alongside product code

overviews.note: Scanner-blind: summary wrongly calls the whole system the TS frontend, so lead with key points whose concrete web_src pointers stay true; children is one collapsed container.
For the container the frontend framing is accurate: summary + key points give the init order and observer seam; 182 children open with eslint/playwright configs so they go last; parent redundant.
